analysis.purpose: cmdContextByScope implements the bulk `crib context --package|--file|--cluster <id>` path. It resolves the scope value (which may ride the flag or appear as a positional), validates it, opens the verb/index store, and prints a scoped dossier via verbs.dossierByScope with optional table inclusion, max-symbols limit, output format, and extracted-only filter.
responsibilities: Map scope kind to the corresponding CLI flag
Resolve the scope id from the flag's next argument or a separate positional non-flag argument
Print scoped usage and return BAD_ARGS when no id is provided
Open the verb/index store via openVerbs
Return NOT_INDEXED if the store cannot be opened
Call verbs.dossierByScope with the resolved parameters
Close the index store before returning

businessRules.rule: Scope id may ride the flag or be positional
businessRules.rationale: afterFlag is used if non-flag; otherwise the first non-flag arg not equal to flagIdx+1 is used
When !id, usage is printed and EXIT.BAD_ARGS is returned

businessRules.rule: maxSymbols is honored only when it is a finite positive number
businessRules.rationale: The option is passed only if Number.isFinite(maxSymbols) && maxSymbols > 0

businessRules.rule: Format defaults to undefined and only accepts markdown
businessRules.rationale: format is set to 'markdown' only when args[fmtIdx+1] === 'markdown'; otherwise it falls back to undefined (json)

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: CLI arguments including scope flag, id, and formatting options

sideEffects: Writes scoped usage text to process.stderr when id is missing
Writes formatted JSON to process.stdout on success
Opens and closes the index store
errorBehavior: parseInt failure produces NaN, which is filtered out by Number.isFinite
invariants: The index store is closed before returning
A scope id is always resolved before verbs.dossierByScope is called
preconditions: A scope flag and corresponding id must be present
The crib index must be openable
postconditions: Either the scoped dossier JSON is printed or an error code is returned
risks: Manual argument parsing allows ambiguous combinations (e.g. both --package and --file present; only the mapped flag is considered)
maxSymbols uses Number.parseInt without radix, relying on default base-10 for typical inputs
8 unresolved call sites (Array.indexOf, String.startsWith, Array.find, process.stderr.write, Number.parseInt, process.stdout.write, JSON.stringify, Number.isFinite) are not modeled
whatToDistrust: 8 unresolved built-in/array call sites; exact parsing and formatting behavior is assumed
dossierByScope contract and behavior are not validated in this seed
